source.author: cic
source.text: nam etsi non sus Minervam ut aiunt, tamen inepte quisquis Minervam docet.
source.text_original: nam etsi non sus Minervam ut aiunt, tamen inepte quisquis Minervam docet.
source.text_english: For although a pig does not teach Minerva, as the saying goes, still whoever teaches Minerva is acting foolishly.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: unde et nos oblitae uirium nostrarum et non, quid possimus, sed, quid uelimus, tantum cogitantes magistram cupimus docere discipulae et, ut est uulgare prouerbium: sus artium reppertricem.
reuse.text_original: unde et nos oblitae uirium nostrarum et non, quid possimus, sed, quid uelimus, tantum cogitantes magistram cupimus docere discipulae et, ut est uulgare prouerbium: sus artium reppertricem.
reuse.text_english: And so we, forgetful of our own strength and thinking not of what we can do, but only of what we wish, are eager to teach as disciples the teacher, and, as the common proverb goes, the sow the discoverer of arts.
